lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in a repeating grid-like pattern posterior to the five gill slits, forming vertically aligned columns that extend across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating distinct anchor nodes in a rectangular tessellation across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with light-saturated upper pixels and shadowed lower pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple yellow-pigmented organisms (Gnathanodon speciosus) positioned along the mid-flank and a single elongated remora attached to the ventral-posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
